how.heading: How it works
how.intro: Four corners, four crosshairs, one bottle per team. The yellow circle is about the size of a bottle base.
how.step_1_text: 2 versus 2 on the short sides. Each player has a corner — and each crosshair belongs to exactly one player.
how.step_1_alt: Capshot mat with four bottle caps on the corner crosshairs and two bottles on the yellow circles
how.step_2_text: Full bottle on the yellow circle on your side. The circle is about the size of the bottle base — don't put it on the fields.
how.step_2_alt: Beer bottle standing on the yellow circle of the Capshot mat, circle about the size of the bottle base
how.step_3_text: Place your bottle cap on your crosshair. You flick from here — not from anywhere else on the mat.
how.step_3_alt: Bottle cap centred on the magenta crosshair in the corner of the mat
how.step_4_text: Flick with your finger across the field. Whoever throws, drinks. If it lands in the other team's field, they drink. Yellow counts for more. First bottle empty wins.
how.step_4_alt: Finger flicking the bottle cap from the crosshair toward the playing fields

faq.heading: Before you start
faq.aside_lede: Short answers on the mat, the game and shipping — or go straight to the order.
faq.q1: How many people do I need?
faq.a1: Four is best — two teams of two. With two players you can duel on the short sides.
faq.q2: What do I need to play?
faq.a2: A table with room for the mat (38 × 106 cm), full bottles with crown caps, the mat and instructions from the box — plus at least two players.
faq.a3: Yes. Soft drinks, shandy, water. The skill stays.
faq.q4: How do I clean the mat?
faq.a4: Wipe it damp, let it dry, roll it up.
faq.q5: How does Capshot work, in short?
faq.a5: Flick the crown cap with your thumb and hit fields on the other side. If the cap hits, the other team's bottle drinks. Empty their bottle and you win the round.
faq.a6: Usual 0.33 l and 0.5 l longneck bottles fit the marks. They need to be full, capped, and standing securely.
faq.a7: The playing mat (38 × 106 cm), the cylindrical tube for storage, and the instructions.
faq.q8: Can I order if I don't live in Germany?
faq.a8: We currently ship free within Germany. For other countries, write to us via the contact form and we'll tell you whether delivery is possible.

regeln.heading: Capshot rules
regeln.hero_title: Capshot rules — bottle-cap flicking for parties
regeln.hero_image_alt: Party mood with Capshot on the table
regeln.intro: This page is a short overview of the most important Capshot rules. First time playing? This summary is enough for the night — settle details fairly on the table.
regeln.toc_heading: What you'll find in this article
regeln.equipment_bottles_value: Per team: 0.3 l & 0.5 l (with or without alcohol)
regeln.equipment_table_value: Room for the mat and four players
regeln.fairplay_text: Capshot is a join-in game — loud is fine, disrespect is not. No shoving at the table, no pouring drinks on the mat. Drink responsibly and look out for each other.
regeln.gameplay_heading: Capshot rules — how a round plays
regeln.gameplay_li_1: Fixed shooting order — diagonal and around the table
regeln.gameplay_li_2: Hits on the opponent’s zones → the opponent’s team drinks
regeln.gameplay_li_3: Caps lying upside down on a zone count double
regeln.gameplay_li_4: You may knock opponent caps on the field (crosshair rules are the exception)
regeln.start_li_1: 4 players — 2 vs 2 on the short sides
regeln.start_li_2: Two full bottles per team: one 0.3 l and one 0.5 l (with or without alcohol)
regeln.start_li_3: One bottle cap per player on their own crosshair
regeln.start_li_4: Bottles sit on the yellow circles on your side
regeln.start_rps: Rock, paper, scissors decides who starts. The winning team chooses which team opens.
regeln.start_crosshair: Your own cap must sit 100% on your crosshair at the start — otherwise you skip that round.
regeln.order_intro: After the opening shot you rotate in a fixed order:
regeln.order_1: The corner player who has the opening shot
regeln.order_3: The table neighbour of player 2 (not the player from step 1)
regeln.order_note: That way all four corners take turns without one team shooting twice in a row.
regeln.scoring_intro: When a cap lands on the opponent’s side, they drink according to the zone.
regeln.scoring_row_1_value: Minus-1 zone — reduces the value by 1 (minimum 0)
regeln.scoring_row_5_value: The team on that side adds an extra drink — on top of the normal value
regeln.scoring_overlap: If one cap sits on two zones at once, the higher value counts — e.g. minus-1 and 1-zone → 1-zone; 1- and 2-zone → 2-zone; 2-zone and triple zone → triple zone.
regeln.scoring_extra_beer: The extra-beer zone sits behind the bottles: if it is hit, that side provides or buys an additional drink (decide before you start).
regeln.caps_li_1: A cap lying upside down on a zone counts double.
regeln.caps_li_2: You may knock opponent caps on the playing field — not on crosshairs and not when caps are locked by the crosshair rules below.
regeln.caps_li_3: Shots start and end at your own crosshair (exceptions: bonus shots with the opponent’s cap on your crosshair, see below).
regeln.caps_crosshair_intro: If an opponent’s cap lands on your crosshair, that cap may never be moved again. What you may shoot and in which order depends on the situation:
regeln.caps_scenario_a_text: You have already shot this round and your crosshair is empty. Once all four players have taken their turn, you must not move the opponent’s cap on your crosshair — you shoot it one more time instead.
regeln.caps_scenario_b_text: Your own cap is still on the crosshair (even the smallest overlap counts). If the opponent’s cap touches yours when landing or resting, neither cap may be moved. You choose whether to shoot your own cap first or the opponent’s cap first.
regeln.caps_scenario_c_title: Scenario 3 — no contact with your cap
regeln.caps_scenario_c_text: The opponent’s cap lands on your crosshair without touching your own cap. You may move your own cap freely (not the opponent’s) and again choose the order you shoot in.
regeln.win_text: The first team to finish both drinks on its side wins — the 0.3 l and 0.5 l bottles (with or without alcohol). Then rematch or swap sides.
